segmentation.text: or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency
which is moving or preparing to move in any direction,
including, without limitation, arriving at or leaving the scene of a crash or other incident,
and making use of flashing lights meeting the requirements of
the driver of any other vehicle shall,
except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer:

As used in this section, “preparing to move” means any indication that is visible to an approaching driver that an authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency is about to move, including, without limitation: (a) A movement of the vehicle; or (b) The use of hand signals by the driver of the vehicle.

elements.justification: 'approaching' the emergency vehicle: the subject moves (kin.speed above the halt tolerance) with the emergency vehicle ahead in its frame (rel.bearing 'direction of b from a in a's frame', longitudinal component positive), within the centre distance (rel.centre_distance 'Euclidean ground-plane distance between reference points') at which its lamps engage the driver; rel.centre_distance is not used as a clearance or an order of arrival.

Admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-020::authorized_emergency_vehicle ('a vehicle permitted to depart from certain traffic laws when equipped and operated in the manner provided by law'); ru.aggregate 'membership of a legal aggregate'; its conduct is carried by t4 and t6.

ru.official_vehicle 'a vehicle in official or contracted road service ...; kind in {... regulatory_agency ...}', read with kind regulatory_agency; 'Not a stand-in for: an emergency vehicle' respected.

'moving': the emergency vehicle's kin.speed above the halt tolerance. 'preparing to move', as t12 defines it: sig.hand_signal 'a driver's or rider's arm signal; meaning in {no_signal, ...}' other than no_signal, or sig.turn_indicator other than off (read as the indication, not the move it precedes), with the vehicle visible from the subject (rel.visible 'an unobstructed line of sight').

sig.warning_lamp 'a warning lamp lit; colour ..., mode ..., facing ...', read as colour red, mode flashing, facing front from the quoted requirement 'at least one flashing red warning lamp visible from the front'; not a stand-in for an audible warning.
Admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle; 'any other' excludes the emergency vehicle itself; 'driver' read through the vehicle's controlled motion.

Mapping index: 'unless otherwise directed by a Police Officer' maps to dev.governs, dev.human_direction, rel.occupies, st.travel_region; read with role police_officer governing a travel region the subject occupies.
'Proceed': the subject continues to move, kin.speed 'magnitude of velocity' above the halt tolerance; the manner of proceeding is the standard t11.

The definition of 'preparing to move' used by t4: 'any indication that is visible to an approaching driver' (rel.visible) 'that ... is about to move, including, without limitation: (a) A movement of the vehicle' (kin.speed) 'or (b) The use of hand signals' (sig.hand_signal); the open list also read through sig.turn_indicator.

operationalizations.convention: caution is read through the conduct it secures toward the emergency vehicle: no traffic-conflict with it (closest approach of the centres under constant velocities within the time-to-collision threshold below the collision clearance), no contact, and, while side by side with it, a gap between bodies of at least the lateral passing clearance

compositions.quote: at least one flashing red warning lamp visible from the front

residues.why: illustrative: arriving at or leaving a scene are instances of moving or preparing to move, which t4 already reads; the duty is the same whether or not the vehicle is arriving at or leaving a scene

applicability: There is a road user e, not the subject, of the authorized-emergency-vehicle aggregate or an official vehicle of kind regulatory_agency, showing a lit warning lamp of colour red, mode flashing, facing front, that is moving (kin.speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance) or preparing to move (visible from the subject, rel.visible, with a hand signal other than no_signal or a turn indicator other than off); the subject is approaching e: it moves (kin.speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance), e lies ahead of it in its frame (rel.bearing longitudinal positive) or the two are side by side (rel.longitudinal_overlap at or above zero), and their centre distance is at most p.emergency_approach_reach. And no human_direction device of role police_officer governs a travel region the subject occupies.
obligation: For every such e: the subject and e are not in contact; it is not the case that their closest approach falls within p.conflict_horizon at a centre distance below p.conflict_centre_clearance; and where rel.longitudinal_overlap of the subject and e is at or above zero, rel.surface_gap between them is at least p.emergency_pass_clearance.

narrowings.why: 'driver' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion
'preparing to move' is defined (t12) as an indication 'visible to an approaching driver': read as the emergency vehicle being visible from the subject (rel.visible) while it gives the indication
caution, a standard of the driver's care, is read only through the clearance the subject keeps from the emergency vehicle; its speed is judged by NRS_484B_267_2a

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: Ambulance e, moving with a lit red flashing front lamp, is ahead of the moving subject within p.emergency_approach_reach; the subject passes alongside it with rel.surface_gap below p.emergency_pass_clearance while rel.longitudinal_overlap is at or above zero.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but the subject passes with a gap of at least p.emergency_pass_clearance and no closest-approach conflict or contact.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: e's warning lamps are off as the subject approaches and passes.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but sig.warning_lamp is not observed, so whether the duty is engaged is unknown.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: The subject closes on e from behind in its lane; their closest approach falls within p.conflict_horizon below p.conflict_centre_clearance.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: e stands at rest with its lamps flashing, no hand signal and no turn indicator: it is neither moving nor preparing to move.

param_proposals.name: p.halt_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution
param_proposals.source: speed resolution of the acquisition standard's vehicle-state estimates

param_proposals.name: p.emergency_approach_reach
param_proposals.convention: centre distance within which a driver approaching an emergency or enforcement vehicle that shows flashing warning lamps counts as approaching it: about the distance at which the lamps are conspicuous by day and a driver at an urban speed of 15 m/s has ten seconds to slow
param_proposals.source: emergency warning-light conspicuity studies; move-over law guidance

param_proposals.name: p.conflict_horizon
param_proposals.convention: time-to-collision threshold of the traffic-conflict technique: a closest approach later than this is not a present danger of a crash
param_proposals.source: traffic-conflict technique literature (Hyden; FHWA Surrogate Safety Assessment Model)

param_proposals.name: p.conflict_centre_clearance
param_proposals.convention: centre-to-centre distance at the closest approach below which the bodies of a passenger car and another road user are taken to collide or nearly collide: about a car's half-length plus half a body width

param_proposals.name: p.emergency_pass_clearance
param_proposals.convention: the gap between bodies a driver keeps while passing alongside an emergency or enforcement vehicle: a lateral passing clearance of about half a lane's free width, leaving room for its crew and doors
param_proposals.source: lateral passing-clearance conventions of driver manuals and move-over guidance
